The account here largely follows those of [16], [10] and [14].

blocks.content:
Some basic elements in the annulus
In Hn there is a known set of idempotent elements, Eλ, one for each partition
λ of n. These elements were originally given a purely algebraic description by
Gyoja [3], and were subsequently given a skein picture based on the Young
diagram for λ by the second author and Aiston [16].
The closure of Eλ
gives the element Qλ ∈C+, making up the basis elements used in [16], and
indirectly those used in [10]. Our construction makes use only of the sequence
of elements {hn} ∈C+ which arise from the single row Young diagrams, and

When an element X ∈C is used to decorate a framed knot K, the Homﬂy
polynomial, P(K; X) ∈Λ, of the decorated knot gives a 2-variable invariant
of K determined by X. Each basis element Qλ,µ gives such an invariant of
K, and these determine the invariants for all choices of X. When µ = φ
these invariants, for each ﬁxed λ, give a family of 1-variable invariants after
setting v = s−N which coincide, up to a power of s, with the quantum group
invariants of K determined by the irreducible sl(N)q-module corresponding
to the partition λ.
